ideas.pitch: Real-time occupancy and arrival time estimator for university shuttles using roadside edge cameras and lightweight object detection.
ideas.title: CampusShuttle Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a tangible campus pain point for students at Western University with a live computer vision demo, echoing the live-working-demo pattern from winning hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: Crowdsourced and sensor-verified library and study space availability tracker across Western University's campus.
ideas.title: StudySpot AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable problem for hackathon judges and students who struggle to find quiet places to study during midterms.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered ticket routing and severity classifier for university residence maintenance requests using natural language processing.
ideas.title: ResLife Maintenance Prioritizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies enterprise workflow automation to a university administration problem, appealing to judges looking for practical operational efficiency tools.

ideas.pitch: Real-time lecture summarization and interactive mind-map generator for students attending fast-paced university lectures.
ideas.title: LectureLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages generative AI to produce a visually compelling frontend demo that students and academic judges can immediately test on their own notes.

ideas.pitch: Automated expense auditing and receipt categorization tool specifically tailored for student union clubs and organizations.
ideas.title: CampusClub Budget Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets student councils and club executives with a concrete financial utility, demonstrating clear commercial and organizational viability.
